definition: median_i min_j ||gen_i - train_j||  /  median_i min_j ||real_test_i - train_j||
interpretation: 1.0 = generated paths sit no closer to the training set than genuine held-out data; <1 = memorisation, 1/ratio = how many times closer they sit
note: Exact duplicates being 0 does NOT clear the method: SBTS interpolates between training paths, so it produces near-copies rather than copies. The ratio is the number that matters. The committed d = 1 SBTS entry scores 0.158 on this same diagnostic, so a low ratio is a property of SBTS at K=20, not of the d = 8 dataset.
